title: Additional Injuries Prompt DeVilbiss to Reannounce Recall of Pressure Washers and Air Compressors Due to Fracture and Laceration Hazards
summary: The pressure washers and air compressors have pneumatic tires with plastic hubs that can burst, posing fracture and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 620,000 pressure washers and 72,000 compressors (Previously recalled in December 2006).

title: Daiso Recalls Children's Toys, Purses and Pen Cases Due to Violation of Lead Paint and Phthalate Limits
summary: The surface paint on the balancing toys and zippers of the purses and pen cases contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint ban. The inflatable baseball bat toys contain excessive levels of DEHP, violating the federal phthalate standard Units: About 130.

title: Directors Chairs Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Made by White Tiger
summary: The chair back supports can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 84,000.

title: Guardian Full-Face Diving Masks Recalled by Ocean Technology Due to Visor Separation Hazard
summary: The plastic portion of the step can break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 900.

title: Wooden Toys Recalled by Daiso Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The toys have small parts that can break and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 430.

title: Paula Deen Cast Iron Cookware Sold by QVC Recalled Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards; Distributed by Meyer Trading Co. LTD
summary: The recalled cookware can crack or shatter, posing burn and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 51,000.

title: Diving Equipment Recalled by Halcyon Manufacturing Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The over pressure valves (OPVs) in the diving equipment could fail allowing the buoyancy compensator devices (BCDs) and the diver lift inflatable devices to leak, posing a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 20,300.

title: Blair Expands Recall To All Women's Chenille Apparel Due to Burn Hazard; Additional Reported Deaths Prompt Re-Announcement of Robe Recall
summary: Some of these products fail to meet the federal flammability standard and present a risk of serious burns to consumers if the garments are exposed to an open flame. Units: About 138,000.

title: Coby Electronics Recalls Rechargeable Batteries Sold with Portable DVD/CD/MP3 Players Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rechargeable batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 19,600.

title: Flatware Recalled by Cambridge Silversmiths Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic decorative inserts on the flatware's handles can detach during dishwashing, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 13,000.

title: Toro Recalls Zero Turn Mowers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The coolant overflow container on the recalled mowers can become over-pressurized and cause hot coolant to spray on the operator. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,100.

title: Haunted House Screen Candle Holders Recalled by Coyne's & Co. Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Yankee Candle
summary: The window panes on the screen can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,800.

title: Idea Village Recalls Wireless Light Switches Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The light switch receiver, which fits into the wall outlet, can overheat and pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.3 million.

title: Off-Road Utility Vehicles Recalled by Bad Boy Enterprises Due To Crash Hazard
summary: The off-road vehicles can accelerate without warning, posing a risk of injury to the user and/or bystander. Units: About 3,900.

title: Wincraft Inc. Recalls Sports Themed Lamps Due to Fire, Burn and Shock Hazards
summary: An electrical problem with the lamps can pose fire, burn and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 145.

title: Raynor Marketing Recalls Quantum Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Office Depot Stores
summary: The bolts attaching the seatback on the recalled chairs can loosen and detach, posing a fall and injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 150,000.

title: Single Meter Sockets Recalled by Milbank Manufacturing Due to Fire and Electrocution Hazards
summary: A short may occur while in use due to an incorrect bridge installed in the product, to which the meter clips are attached. If the manufacturing defect exists, all metal parts of the meter could create a shock or burns can occur if the cover is off and the meter socket is energized. Units: About 1,40

title: Zero Motorcycles Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle on the recalled motorcycles can become stuck in the open position or become disconnected. In the "Easy" or the "0-25" mode, this can unexpectedly lead to full power when turning on the power, resulting in a loss of control and serious injury to the rider. Units: About 200.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Bicycles with Front Trays or Baskets; Trays and Baskets Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
summary: The front tray or basket on the bicycles can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 6,400 (3,000 units were previously recalled in March 2009).

title: Moser Enterprises Recalls Schwalbe Brand Bicycle Tires Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The tire layers could separate causing the inner tube to rupture, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,000.

title: SI Tech Recalls Diving Suit Hoses Due to Drowning Hazard; One Death Reported
summary: The hose contains an insert that can dislodge during diving and restrict air flow to the diver, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 65,000.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Oil can leak into the engine compartment, posing a fire hazard to consumers. In addition, the fuel tank can come into contact with the engine posing a possibility of wearing through and fuel leakage. Units: About 3,000.

title: Halloween Flashlights Sold Exclusively at Target Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The flashlights can overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 610,000.

title: Sony Recalls Computer AC Adapters Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Insulation inside the AC adapter can fail over time, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 69,000.

title: Belkin International Inc. Recalls SurgeMaster Surge Protectors Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The molding of the plastic 360 degree rotating plug, which allows for easy cord movement, can crack or detach from the plug assembly, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 68,700.

title: Near Strangulation of Child Prompts Recall of Roman Shades by Whole Space; Sold Exclusively by Hanover Direct/Domestications
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 90,000.

title: Near Strangulation of Children Prompts Recall of Roman Shades by Louis Hornick & Co.; Sold Exclusively at Bed Bath & Beyond
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 364,000.

title: Risk of Strangulation Prompts Recall to Repair IKEA Roller Blinds
summary: Strangulations can occur if the blind's looped bead chain is not attached to the wall or the floor with the tension device provided and a child's neck becomes entangled in the free-standing loop. Units: About 533,000.
